description: This file defines the LocalTasksBlock class for Drupal, which provides a block to display local task tabs (primary and secondary) in the menu system. It includes methods for building the block, configuration, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Menu\Plugin\Block\LocalTasksBlock
classes.description: Defines a Drupal block plugin that displays local task tabs (primary and secondary) for menu navigation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the local task manager and route match dependencies.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the block, including display options for primary and secondary tabs.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the render array for the block, including cacheability and tab visibility based on configuration.

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Provides a form for configuring which tabs (primary/secondary) are shown.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to save configuration settings.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Indicates that the block can be used as a placeholder.
